svg.title: The three numbers
svg.desc: 4,000 of 4,000 steps with exactly the right state, in one run on Gemini 3.8 Flash with 3.7 million tokens. A step with the right state cost 4.5 times as much when the replies were applied as written, on the first 400 requests. 46 of 46 slips, where the model left out a service's connections, repaired by a fixed rule.
